title: Scoped Threads
goal: Borrow local stack data safely across threads using scoped execution.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Scoped Threads

sections.text: Standard `thread::spawn` requires all captured values to live for `'static`. That forces you to move ownership or clone values into `Arc` handles.

sections.caption: Moving ownership is required with plain spawn.

sections.text: `thread::scope` creates a bounded region for threads. The function blocks until every thread spawned inside the scope finishes.

sections.caption: s.spawn borrows v without moving it.

sections.text: Because all child threads finish before `thread::scope` returns, borrowing local stack variables is completely safe. Standard borrowing rules still apply.

explanation: Borrow local stack data safely across threads using scoped execution.
